title: Creamy Mushroom Rigatoni
description: A hearty Italian-inspired pasta dish loaded with sautéed shiitake and button mushrooms in a rich and creamy velvety sauce.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the rigatoni according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, sauté the sliced shiitake and button mushrooms over medium heat until tender.
Add the velvety sauce to the skillet with the mushrooms and stir to combine.
Add the cooked rigatoni to the skillet with the sauce and toss to coat.
Transfer the rigatoni mixture to a serving dish.
Sprinkle the macaron cheese on top and serve hot.
